task: ae.units: exact dimensional-analysis units library with expression parser, affine temperatures and Quantity arithmetic
reasoning_summary: Exact BigInteger rationals avoid rounding in conversions; dimensions are 7-exponent vectors; the parser is a small recursive descent with exact-symbol-before-prefix resolution and resource budgets on exponents and factor size. Affine units (degC/degF) are rejected from all compound operations so offsets never get multiplied. Tests were written first and checked against published literals, an independent factor table, a random expression evaluator and a 27-mutant pass (two survivors fixed with budget tests).
